messages:
Maya Li: Rough proposal: add per-route redact_budget + a client hint header so noisy routes rarely capture raw payloads but owners can still inspect canaries. header: X-Redwood-Redact: none|partial|full (advisory).
Connor Reed: Server must treat header as hint; enforce tenant/route max. Also need sticky sampling keyed by client_id so auditing isn't churny.
Diego Alvarez: Security: sample_id should be HMAC-signed and console must present signed inspector tokens to fetch raw. No raw returns without RBAC + audit log.
Priya Nair: UX: route page shows budget %, sparkline, recent sampled events (metadata only). Each sample has a "Request unmask" action that opens a modal with TTL + justification. Auto-approve for route owners optional.
Maya Li: Sampling math: budget_left = route_quota - used; sampling_p = clamp(budget_left / expected_rate, 0, 1); sample if sticky_hash(client_id) < sampling_p. Attach effective_policy + redact_level to sample record.
Connor Reed: Add metrics: sampling.budget_remaining, sampling.sticky_hit_rate, sampling.unmask.requests, sampling.unmask.approved, sampling.tokens_saved_est. Ops want the cost delta.
Diego Alvarez: Ops rule: if budget_left < 5% then auto-fallback to full redact for non-owner tokens and page oncall. Also expose a kill-switch on route page.
Priya Nair: Implementation notes: store only redacted blobs by default; fetch raw on-demand for approved inspect requests. Rotate tenant HMAC keys, use single-use inspector tokens.
Maya Li: Pseudo sample record: { "route": "/v1/chat", "redact_hint": "partial", "effective_policy": "quota-capped", "sample_id": "s_20260304_01", "sample_sig": "hmac:...", "sampled": true }
Connor Reed: Who takes server proto + budget calc? Diego for HMAC/token flow?
Diego Alvarez: I'll take HMAC + token validation and draft runbook. Can also add auto-fallback logic.
Priya Nair: I'll draft the RFC with policy schema and console mockups. Maya will own server sampler.
